The contract will support the ongoing operation, maintenance and enhancement of the NTA’s ServiceNow environment and facilitate future platform developments and service improvements. Full details of the requirements are set out in the procurement documentation. The initial contract term is two years, with the option to extend for up to three additional periods of one year each, giving a maximum contract term of five years.
